title: Training Note: Harvest Agreement and Arrangement Relief in a Security Deposits Recalculation
content:
The recalculation of a held Security Deposits deposit takes account of payment arrangements the member saw through, as recorded under Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements).

## The rule

The harvest relief is the harvest relief figure of **0.15** when the member completed an Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement that ended in the last twenty-four whole months, the general arrangement relief of **0.05** when the member completed another kind of payment arrangement that ended in that period, and nothing otherwise. The relief is taken off the recalculation multiple. The recalculation multiple is never below **1.0**; that floor is applied once, to the multiple as finally reckoned.

## Questions answered

**What counts as completed?** An arrangement whose status is completed, dated by the date it ended.

**The member completed an Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement that ended fifteen months ago.**
0.15.

**The member's only completed arrangement is a Standard Deferred Payment Agreement that ended ten months ago.**
0.05, the general arrangement relief.

**The member's Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement was defaulted, and a Winter Protection Payment Agreement was completed and ended twenty months ago.**
0.05; the harvest agreement was not completed.

**The member's last completed arrangement ended thirty months ago.**
Nothing.

| Completed arrangement ending in the last twenty-four whole months | Relief |
|---|---|
| an Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | 0.15 |
| another kind of payment arrangement, with no completed harvest agreement in that time | 0.05 |
| none | nothing |
